_comment: Registry of drupilot's tabbed choices and their DRUPILOT_CHOICE_<KEY> pre-answers (resolved and validated by scripts/env/choice.sh). Each entry names the command and tab it answers, the accepted values (the first one listed is not necessarily the tab's default: see 'default'), whether several values may be given ('multi': a comma-separated subset), and what a pre-answer persists to .drupilot.json exactly as the tab's answer would: 'persist_key' copies the value into that setting, 'persist_map' maps a value to {setting: value}. 'preanswer': false marks a fork that must stay a human decision (outward-facing, destructive or privileged); its variable is ignored with a warning. A pre-answer is read through config_get (environment > .drupilot.json > defaults), so the environment variable is the usual way to set it. An explicit command argument (e.g. /drupilot-setup --php, /drupilot-clean --level) always wins over it, and an environment variable of the persisted setting itself (e.g. DRUPILOT_PHP_TARGET) still wins over the persisted value.

INTENT.note: Answers only the ambiguous-intent tab; an explicit mode word wins. 'auto' is as safe as the auto mode word: it never pushes, opens a Merge Request or contributes.

TARGET_MAJOR.note: 12 is a pre-release: it is offered only with DRUPILOT_ALLOW_PRERELEASE=true and ports to it as a preview. A --target N argument wins; the answer is persisted only after the draft upgrade plan resolves.

PHP_TARGET.note: 8.5 needs Drupal 11.3 or later: it is accepted, with a warning when the Drupal target or the installed core is older. A --php X.Y argument wins.

PLACEMENT.note: For a module inside a repository, 'move' becomes 'copy' (moving would delete it from the repository); 'symlink' and 'copy' are kept, and 'symlink' edits the repository directly.

CONFIG_CONFLICT.note: What to do with a hand-edited rector.php / phpstan.neon / phpcs.xml.dist that differs from the template ('replace' backs the old copy up first).

EXISTING_WORK.note: Asked only when an upstream Drupal 11 issue looks like a match.

DIGESTS_RULES.note: The tab's default, 'Review and pick', is a per-rule review and cannot be pre-answered; leave the variable unset to get it.

PORT_ATTRIBUTES.note: 'add' adds the attributes next to the annotations and raises core_version_requirement (e.g. ^10.3 || ^11).

D10_CHECK.note: Asked only when the core matrix finds a Drupal 10 incompatibility.

LEARN.note: 'all' records every proposed pattern whose detector was checked against the pre-port code; 'none' records nothing.

NEXT_STEP.note: 'refactor' applies only after /drupilot-port. Contributing upstream and the issue-comment patch are never pre-answered.

PATCH_KIND.note: 'issue' still needs the issue id (the command's second argument); without it the id is asked.

PUSH.note: The push is the point of no return and stays a human decision in semi mode. DRUPILOT_CONTRIB_MODE=auto is the explicit setting that skips this tab.

CLEAN_CONFIRM.note: Deleting a test-bed always needs an explicit answer after the preview. The cached base cores are removed only with the --core-cache argument.

DOCTOR_INSTALL.note: drupilot never installs software without an explicit confirmation.

LAYERS_PLAN.note: Adding the proposed dependencies edits info.yml files and always needs a confirmation, so it is not a pre-answer.
